La opción C) sugiere un tesoro, lo que podría sonar emocionante, pero no está relacionado con la narrativa del descubrimiento de historias en el diario. La opción D) sugiere la existencia de una habitación oculta, pero el texto se enfoca en el diario como el hallazgo significativo. Este enfoque sobre la identificación de detalles específicos es relevante para la competencia de comprensión lectora.

ingles.context_text: Emily has always been fascinated by the ocean. Every summer, she visits her grandparents who live by the seaside. During her visits, she collects shells and learns about marine life. This year, she decided to take part in a beach clean-up event organized by local volunteers. Emily spent the day picking up trash, and at the end of the event, she felt proud knowing she contributed to keeping the ocean clean for future generations.
ingles.question: What motivated Emily to participate in the beach clean-up event?
options: A) To collect more shells.
B) To help maintain a clean ocean.
C) To meet new friends.
D) To learn more about marine life.
ingles.skill: Comprensión lectora; Identifica la intención del autor.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) porque el texto menciona específicamente que Emily se sintió orgullosa de contribuir a mantener el océano limpio. Las otras opciones, aunque podrían ser motivos válidos, no se mencionan en el contexto. A) hace referencia a su actividad de recolectar conchas, pero no es la razón principal de su participación en el evento. C) se refiere a conocer nuevos amigos, lo cual no es el enfoque del texto. D) aprender sobre la vida marina también es un interés de Emily, pero no es la razón directa para su participación en la limpieza de playas. Por lo tanto, la opción B) es la más adecuada y representa la comprensión de la motivación de Emily.

ingles.context_text: Jack loves to explore new places, especially during the summer vacations. Last year, he traveled to the mountains where he discovered breathtaking views and unique wildlife. Each day, he embarked on a new adventure, hiking through trails, and taking photographs of the stunning scenery. Jack also enjoyed camping under the stars and making new friends from different parts of the world who shared his passion for nature.
ingles.question: What is Jack's main interest during his summer vacations?
options: A) Camping in the forest.
B) Exploring new places.
C) Meeting new friends.
D) Taking photographs of wildlife.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) 'Exploring new places', ya que el texto menciona específicamente que Jack disfruta de explorar nuevos lugares durante sus vacaciones de verano. Las opciones A), C) y D) representan actividades que Jack disfruta, pero no encapsulan su interés principal como lo hace la opción B). Esto puede llevar a algunos estudiantes a confundirse, ya que pueden pensar que una de esas actividades es más relevante, pero el enfoque general del texto es la exploración.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, a group of friends decided to organize a community picnic to strengthen their bonds and encourage cooperation among neighbors. They planned various activities, including games for children, a potluck lunch, and a talent show. Excitement grew as people began to sign up, but they also faced challenges such as weather uncertainty and different dietary preferences. Nonetheless, they remained committed to making the picnic a memorable event for everyone involved.
ingles.question: What was the main purpose of the community picnic organized by the friends?
options: A) To raise money for local charities.
B) To foster connections among neighbors.
C) To compete in games and sports.
D) To celebrate a holiday.
ingles.justification: La pregunta busca evaluar la capacidad del estudiante para identificar la idea principal del texto. La opción correcta (B) refleja claramente el objetivo de la actividad, que es fortalecer lazos entre los vecinos. Las alternativas A, C y D son distractores que, aunque plausibles, no se mencionan en el contexto del texto, lo que puede llevar a confusión. Por ejemplo, el texto no hace referencia a la recaudación de fondos ni a la celebración de un holiday, lo que significa que estas opciones no son correctas. En el análisis, se puede destacar que las actividades planificadas, como juegos y un almuerzo compartido, refuerzan la idea de unión y cooperación, lo cual está alineado con la opción B.

ingles.context_text: Emma loves to paint. Every Saturday, she visits a local art studio where she practices her skills. She enjoys experimenting with different colors and techniques. Last week, she painted a landscape, showcasing a beautiful sunset over the mountains. Emma dreams of becoming a professional artist one day and often shares her work on social media to gain feedback from friends and family.
ingles.question: What activity does Emma enjoy doing every Saturday?
options: A) Writing stories
B) Painting
C) Playing sports
D) Cooking
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en identificar la actividad principal que realiza Emma, que es pintar. La opción B es correcta, ya que el contexto menciona explícitamente que Emma disfruta de la pintura en el estudio. Las opciones A, C y D son distractores que presentan actividades comunes pero que no se mencionan en el texto, lo que puede confundir a los estudiantes que no recuerden los detalles específicos sobre la actividad de Emma. Esta pregunta evalúa la habilidad del estudiante para extraer información concreta del texto proporcionado.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that contained thousands of books. Every Saturday, children from the neighborhood would gather to listen to stories read by the librarian. One day, a new child arrived, curious about the stories and eager to join. The librarian welcomed him and asked what kind of stories he liked. The child smiled and said he loved adventures. That week, the librarian chose a thrilling adventure book that captivated all the children. They laughed and gasped at each twist and turn of the story.
ingles.question: What type of stories does the new child prefer?
options: A) Love stories
B) Adventure stories
C) Horror stories
D) Mystery stories
ingles.justification: The question asks about the preference of the new child regarding stories. The correct answer is B) Adventure stories, as the text explicitly states that the child loves adventures. The other options are distractors that do not reflect the child's expressed preference, making them incorrect. A) Love stories, C) Horror stories, and D) Mystery stories do not appear anywhere in the context and are therefore misleading. This test assesses the ability to extract specific information from the text, which is a crucial reading comprehension skill.

ingles.context_text: The invention of the internet has transformed the way people communicate and access information. Before the internet, accessing data often required going to libraries or reading books. Now, with just a few clicks, one can find an answer to almost any question from the comfort of their home. This shift has influenced various sectors, including education, business, and entertainment. For students, the internet provides a vast resource for research and learning, but it also raises concerns about misinformation and the importance of critical thinking skills.
ingles.question: What is one of the main concerns raised by the internet's impact on education?
options: A) It has increased the number of libraries.
B) It has facilitated easier access to misinformation.
C) It has decreased the amount of available information.
D) It has reduced the need for communication.
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en un aspecto crítico del impacto que tiene el internet en la educación. La opción correcta, B), menciona la preocupación por la desinformación, que es un tema relevante en el contexto actual. Las alternativas A) y C) son distractores que desvían de la discusión sobre la calidad de la información, mientras que D) es incorrecta porque el internet ha facilitado la comunicación, no la ha reducido. Este análisis ayuda a los estudiantes a enfocarse en los temas de crítica y análisis dentro del contexto de la tecnología moderna.

ingles.context_text: The sun was setting over the horizon, painting the sky in hues of orange and pink. As the day came to an end, the town began to quiet down. Families gathered in their homes, while the sound of laughter and children playing faded into the distance. It was a typical evening in the small town, where everyone knew each other and life moved at a gentle pace.
ingles.question: What does the author imply about the town in the passage?
options: A) It is a bustling city with a lot of noise.
B) It is a peaceful place where people are close-knit.
C) It has a lot of tourist attractions to visit.
D) It is a large town with many strangers.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: The passage describes a small town where families gather at home and the atmosphere is calm and quiet, indicating a close-knit community. Distractor A suggests a busy city, which contrasts with the description given. Distractor C introduces the idea of tourist attractions, which is not mentioned in the context. Distractor D implies there are many strangers, contradicting the notion of familiarity among the residents. The correct answer, B, encapsulates the essence of a peaceful and connected community.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that offered various programs to encourage reading among children. Every Saturday, a storyteller would come to share fascinating tales from around the world. Parents noticed that their children became more engaged in reading and started to borrow more books. This initiative not only improved the children's literacy skills but also fostered a love for storytelling.
ingles.question: What was the primary purpose of the library's Saturday program?
options: A) To encourage parents to read more books.
B) To promote storytelling and improve children's reading skills.
C) To sell books to the community.
D) To organize competitions among children.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B) porque el texto indica que el programa del sábado tiene como fin fomentar el amor por la lectura y la narración de cuentos en los niños. Las otras opciones son distracciones que no reflejan correctamente el propósito del programa. A) se centra en los padres, C) habla de vender libros, y D) menciona competencias, ninguno de los cuales es el foco principal del texto.

ingles.context_text: Maria has recently joined an art class where she learns about different painting techniques. During the first week, she practiced watercolor painting, which allowed her to explore blending colors. She found it challenging but enjoyable, as the colors mixed beautifully on the paper. The next week, the teacher introduced acrylic painting, which dries quickly and offers a vibrant palette. Maria is eager to try it, hoping to create a bold landscape.
ingles.question: What technique did Maria find challenging but enjoyable in her art class?
options: A) Acrylic painting
B) Watercolor painting
C) Oil painting
D) Sketching
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en identificar la técnica de pintura que Maria encontró desafiante pero placentera, la cual se menciona explícitamente en el texto como 'watercolor painting'. Las opciones distractoras como 'A) Acrylic painting' y 'C) Oil painting' se presentan para confundir, ya que son técnicas mencionadas en el contexto, pero no son las que Maria disfrutó. La opción 'D) Sketching' también es una técnica diferente que no aparece en la narrativa, aumentando la dificultad al requerir que el estudiante se enfoque en el detalle de la experiencia de Maria. La correcta identificación de 'B) Watercolor painting' demuestra una buena comprensión del texto.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there lived an elderly woman named Mrs. Thompson who had a beautiful garden. Every spring, she would plant a variety of flowers, including daisies, roses, and tulips. The townspeople often admired her garden and would frequently stop by to take pictures. Mrs. Thompson took great pride in her garden and enjoyed sharing gardening tips with anyone who showed interest. One day, a young boy named Timmy approached her, curious about how she made the flowers bloom so brightly. She smiled and explained that it took patience and care to nurture each plant properly.
ingles.question: What advice did Mrs. Thompson give to Timmy about gardening?
options: A) Water the plants only once a month.
B) Use chemical fertilizers to make them grow fast.
C) Be patient and take care of the plants.
D) Ignore the plants and let nature take its course.
ingles.justification: La opción C es correcta porque en el contexto se menciona que Mrs. Thompson explica a Timmy que se necesita paciencia y cuidado para hacer que las flores crezcan bien. Las otras opciones son distracciones que no se alinean con la filosofía de cuidado y dedicación que se refleja en el texto. A) es incorrecta porque no es suficiente riego, B) sugiere un enfoque poco natural que no es mencionado en el texto y D) contradice la actitud proactiva de Mrs. Thompson hacia el cuidado de las plantas. Esto demuestra que la compresión del texto es clave para identificar la respuesta correcta.

ingles.context_text: A recent study investigated the effects of daily exercise on mental health. Researchers found that individuals who engaged in at least 30 minutes of moderate activity experienced lower levels of anxiety and depression compared to those who were sedentary. The study also suggested that exercise releases endorphins, which contribute to feelings of happiness and well-being.
ingles.question: What is one benefit of daily exercise mentioned in the study?
options: A) It decreases physical strength.
B) It lowers anxiety and depression levels.
C) It causes fatigue.
D) It leads to increased stress.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el texto menciona explícitamente que los individuos que realizan ejercicio moderado diariamente experimentan niveles más bajos de ansiedad y depresión. Las otras opciones representan afirmaciones que contradicen la información presentada en el texto. La opción A es incorrecta ya que no se discute el impacto negativo en la fuerza física, la opción C no es apoyada por el texto, y la opción D es errónea porque el texto señala que el ejercicio contribuye al bienestar, no al estrés.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that was known for its unique collection of rare books. Every Saturday, a group of children would visit the library to learn about the world through stories. The librarian, Mrs. Wilson, would tell them tales of adventure, friendship, and bravery, encouraging their imaginations to soar. One day, she noticed that fewer children were coming to the library, and she wondered how she could inspire more to read.
ingles.question: What is the main purpose of Mrs. Wilson's storytelling?
options: A) To entertain the children with movies.
B) To encourage children to use their imagination.
C) To teach children how to write stories.
D) To explain the importance of rare books.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: The correct answer is B) To encourage children to use their imagination. This option aligns perfectly with the context provided, where Mrs. Wilson inspires children through tales of adventure and bravery. Option A is incorrect because it refers to movies, which are not mentioned in the text. Option C misinterprets Mrs. Wilson's role, as she focuses on storytelling rather than teaching writing. Option D distracts from the core activity of engaging children in reading by mentioning rare books, which is not the main focus of the narrative.

ingles.context_text: In a small village, there was a famous baker known for his delicious bread. Every morning, he would wake up before dawn to prepare the dough using a secret recipe passed down through generations. Villagers would often line up outside his bakery, eager to buy fresh loaves and pastries. However, one day, a new bakery opened nearby, and the competition began to grow. Many wondered if the famous baker could maintain his popularity amidst this new challenge.
ingles.question: What is the main concern of the villagers after the new bakery opened?
options: A) They are excited to try new pastries.
B) They are worried the famous baker might lose customers.
C) They want to help the new bakery succeed.
D) They are indifferent to the opening of the new bakery.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el contexto menciona que los habitantes del pueblo se preguntaban si el panadero famoso podría mantener su popularidad ante la nueva competencia, lo que indica preocupación. Las otras opciones son distractores porque A sugiere entusiasmo, C implica apoyo al nuevo negocio y D muestra indiferencia, pero ninguna refleja la inquietud sobre el impacto en el panadero conocido.

ingles.context_text: Tom is a young artist who loves to paint landscapes. Every weekend, he visits the park to find inspiration. One sunny Saturday, as he was sketching near the pond, he noticed the vibrant colors of the flowers and the reflection of the trees in the water. He decided to capture this beautiful scene in his next painting. With every brushstroke, he felt a sense of peace and happiness. His friends often say that his art expresses the beauty of nature and the joy it brings to his life.
ingles.question: What does Tom enjoy capturing in his paintings?
options: A) Urban architecture
B) Portraits of people
C) Natural landscapes
D) Abstract concepts
ingles.justification: This question tests the student's ability to extract the main idea from the context. The correct answer, 'C) Natural landscapes', directly reflects the content of the text where Tom is described as an artist who loves to paint landscapes. The distractors represent different types of art that are not related to the text: 'A) Urban architecture' and 'B) Portraits of people' do not align with Tom's interests as stated in the context, while 'D) Abstract concepts' diverges from the realistic themes Tom is focused on. Hence, recognizing the main idea is crucial for understanding the text.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, a girl named Sarah dreamed of becoming a great scientist. Every day after school, she would visit the library to read books about space and the stars. Her favorite book, 'The Wonders of the Universe', explained complex concepts in a way that made them easy to understand. Inspired by what she learned, Sarah decided to conduct her own experiments in her backyard, where she built a small telescope to observe the night sky. With dedication and curiosity, she hoped to discover something that could change the world.
ingles.question: What does Sarah do after school?
options: A) She plays sports with her friends.
B) She visits the library to read books.
C) She helps her parents with chores.
D) She watches television at home.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es la opción B, ya que el texto menciona explícitamente que Sarah visita la biblioteca después de la escuela para leer libros sobre el espacio y las estrellas. Las opciones A, C y D son distractores que pueden parecer relevantes, pero no están directamente relacionadas con la actividad principal que realiza Sarah después de la escuela. La opción A introduce una actividad que podría ser común, la opción C presenta una responsabilidad familiar, y la opción D sugiere una actividad pasiva, todas las cuales no reflejan el interés y la dedicación de Sarah hacia la ciencia, lo que la convierte en distracciones apropiadas. Esto enfatiza la importancia de identificar la información clave en el texto.

ingles.context_text: In the heart of a bustling city, a small bookstore stood untouched by the digital age. Inside, the scent of old paper and ink filled the air. The owner, Mrs. Thompson, spent her days recommending books to her loyal customers. One afternoon, a young man entered, looking for a novel that would transport him to another world. Mrs. Thompson smiled, knowing just the right title to suggest, as she had seen many readers find joy in its pages.
ingles.question: What does Mrs. Thompson do in her bookstore?
options: A) She writes novels.
B) She sells electronics.
C) She recommends books.
D) She teaches classes.
ingles.justification: The correct answer is C), as the context clearly states that Mrs. Thompson recommends books to customers. The other options serve as distractors: A) is incorrect because it suggests she writes, which is not mentioned; B) is false since the bookstore focuses on books, not electronics; and D) is misleading as there's no indication of her teaching. This question assesses the ability to identify the main activity described in the text.

ingles.context_text: As the sun began to set, Emily took a deep breath and stepped onto the sandy beach. The waves gently lapped at her feet, creating a soothing rhythm that matched her heartbeat. She felt a sense of peace wash over her as she watched the sky transform into a canvas of oranges, pinks, and purples. Birds soared overhead, and in that moment, Emily knew she had found her perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of city life.
ingles.question: What emotion does Emily primarily feel as she steps onto the beach?
options: A) Anxiety
B) Peace
C) Anger
D) Confusion
ingles.justification: The context describes Emily's experience as she arrives at the beach, emphasizing the soothing rhythm of the waves and the beauty of the sunset. These details suggest a calming and joyful experience rather than one of anxiety, anger, or confusion. The option 'B) Peace' aligns with the overall tone of the passage, making it the correct choice. The other options (A, C, D) are distractors that do not match the emotional tone conveyed by the text.

ingles.context_text: In an effort to promote environmental sustainability, many companies are now adopting green practices. These include using recyclable materials, reducing waste, and implementing energy-efficient technologies. Consumers are increasingly aware of these practices and often choose to support businesses that demonstrate a commitment to protecting the environment. As a result, adopting green strategies can not only benefit the planet but can also enhance a company's image and attract more customers.
ingles.question: What is a potential benefit for companies that adopt green practices?
options: A) They can reduce their workforce.
B) They can increase their energy consumption.
C) They can improve their public image.
D) They can increase their production costs.
ingles.justification: The correct answer is C) They can improve their public image. This option directly aligns with the context provided, which mentions that consumers are more likely to support businesses that show a commitment to environmental sustainability. A) is a distractor, as reducing the workforce is not a beneficial outcome of adopting green practices. B) is incorrect because the text emphasizes energy efficiency, not increasing consumption. D) is also misleading; while some green practices may involve initial investments, they are generally aimed at reducing costs long-term. Hence, C) captures the essence of the text's message regarding the benefits of green practices.

ingles.context_text: Emily loves to read books about adventure. Every weekend, she visits the local library to find new stories that take her to different worlds. She especially enjoys tales where characters overcome obstacles and discover new friendships. One day, while browsing the shelves, she stumbled upon a book titled 'The Lost Treasure of the Ocean'. Intrigued by the cover, she decided to borrow it and couldn't wait to start reading about the journey and challenges faced by the protagonist.
ingles.question: What is the main theme of the book Emily is excited about?
options: A) The importance of friendship
B) Adventures and challenges
C) Mysteries of the ocean
D) Historical events
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en identificar el tema principal del libro mencionado en el texto. La opción correcta es B) 'Adventures and challenges', ya que el contexto describe que Emily elige un libro sobre un tesoro perdido en el océano, sugiriendo una narrativa de aventura y superación. Las otras alternativas pueden resultar atractivas: A) 'The importance of friendship' es un tema común en historias de aventuras, pero no es el principal aquí; C) 'Mysteries of the ocean' tiene relevancia, pero es un enfoque más específico que no abarca la totalidad de la narrativa; D) 'Historical events' no está relacionado con el contexto del libro. Por lo tanto, los distractores ayudan a evaluar la comprensión del lector sobre el tema central presentado.

ingles.context_text: An ancient civilization, known for its impressive architectural feats, flourished along the banks of a great river. The people of this civilization were skilled builders, creating vast cities and monumental structures. Their society was complex, with a rich cultural life that included art, religion, and governance. One of the most remarkable achievements was the construction of a large pyramid that served as a tomb for their leaders. This civilization left behind numerous artifacts, providing insight into their daily lives and beliefs.
ingles.question: What was one notable achievement of the ancient civilization described?
options: A) Development of advanced technology.
B) Construction of a large pyramid.
C) Creation of a written language.
D) Establishment of a democratic government.
ingles.justification: The question focuses on identifying a key achievement mentioned in the context text. Option B is correct as the text explicitly states that the construction of a large pyramid was one of their notable achievements. Option A, while appealing, is not mentioned; the text emphasizes architectural feats rather than technology. Option C is incorrect because there is no reference to a written language in the context. Option D is also inaccurate, as the text does not discuss governance structures in depth. Therefore, B is the best answer based on the provided information.

ingles.context_text: Carlos loves to read books in his free time. His favorite genre is science fiction. Every month, he visits the local library to find new titles. Recently, he discovered a series about space adventures that captivated him completely. He spends hours lost in the stories, imagining himself as the hero exploring distant planets and meeting alien species.
ingles.question: What is Carlos's favorite genre of books?
options: A) Mystery
B) Science fiction
C) Romance
D) Non-fiction
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identify the main idea.
ingles.justification: The context clearly states that Carlos's favorite genre is science fiction. Option B is correct as it directly identifies this preference. Distractors include options A (mystery), C (romance), and D (non-fiction), which are all genres not mentioned in the text, making them incorrect. This question assesses the ability to comprehend and extract specific information from a text.

ingles.context_text: Emily was excited about her upcoming trip to London. She had always dreamed of visiting famous landmarks like the Tower of London and Buckingham Palace. As she packed her suitcase, she thought about the delicious English food she would try, including fish and chips. She also made a list of museums she wanted to explore, such as the British Museum and the Natural History Museum. Emily couldn't wait to take lots of pictures and create memories that would last a lifetime.
ingles.question: What is Emily's main goal for her trip to London?
options: A) To meet new friends.
B) To visit famous landmarks and try local food.
C) To shop for souvenirs.
D) To attend a concert.
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en identificar la idea principal del texto. La opción B es correcta porque resume las principales actividades que Emily espera realizar en Londres: visitar monumentos famosos y probar comida local, que son aspectos clave mencionados en el contexto. Las otras opciones presentan actividades que no se destacan en el texto, como hacer nuevos amigos (A), comprar souvenirs (C), o asistir a un concierto (D), por lo que se convierten en distractores menos relevantes. Esto ayuda a evaluar la comprensión lectora del estudiante sobre el contenido presentado.

ingles.context_text: During a school trip to a science museum, students were fascinated by an exhibit on renewable energy sources. They learned about solar panels, wind turbines, and hydroelectric power. One student said, 'I didn't know how much we rely on these technologies for a sustainable future.' The group realized the importance of these energy sources in combating climate change and preserving the environment for future generations.
ingles.question: What did the students learn about during their trip to the science museum?
options: A) The history of electricity generation.
B) The importance of renewable energy sources.
C) The effects of pollution on wildlife.
D) The development of fossil fuel technology.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es 'B)' porque el texto enfatiza que los estudiantes aprendieron sobre fuentes de energía renovable y su importancia para un futuro sostenible. Las otras opciones ('A)', 'C)' y 'D)') son distracciones que, aunque relacionadas con la energía, no reflejan el enfoque del aprendizaje descrito en el contexto. La opción 'A)' se refiere a la historia, que no es el tema principal, 'C)' menciona un tema de impacto ambiental que no se aborda directamente en el texto, y 'D)' trata sobre tecnología de combustibles fósiles, que contradice la temática de energías renovables.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, a group of friends discovered an old map that led to a hidden treasure. They decided to follow the clues and embark on an adventure, filled with challenges that tested their friendship and determination. As they traveled through the dense forest and crossed rivers, they learned valuable lessons about teamwork and trust.
ingles.question: What was the main lesson learned by the friends during their adventure?
options: A) The importance of individual skills.
B) The benefits of teamwork and trust.
C) The dangers of exploring alone.
D) The significance of maps in treasure hunting.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B), ya que el texto enfatiza cómo la aventura ayudó a los amigos a aprender sobre el trabajo en equipo y la confianza. Las opciones A) y C) son distracciones, porque aunque sugerencias sobre habilidades individuales o explorar solo pueden ser importantes, no son el enfoque principal del texto. La opción D) también puede parecer válida, pero no es el mensaje central que se transmite. Por lo tanto, la respuesta correcta se centra en la colaboración y el vínculo entre los amigos.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that was loved by the community. It hosted weekly reading sessions for children, which encouraged a love for books. The librarian, Mrs. Thompson, often organized events with local authors to inspire young readers. One day, a famous author came to visit and shared his journey of writing. Children were fascinated and many decided they wanted to become writers too.
ingles.question: What was the main purpose of the events organized by Mrs. Thompson?
options: A) To attract more visitors to the library.
B) To inspire children to love books and writing.
C) To sell books at discounted prices.
D) To create a competition among local authors.
ingles.justification: The main idea of the text highlights the efforts of Mrs. Thompson to promote reading among children by organizing events featuring local authors. Option B captures the essence of her intentions, while A exaggerates the purpose, C introduces an unrelated motive of selling, and D misrepresents the nature of the events as competitive rather than inspirational.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that had a collection of rare books. Every Saturday, children would gather to listen to stories read by the librarian, Mrs. Thompson. She had a magical way of bringing the characters to life, making the kids laugh and gasp in excitement. The library also organized weekly reading competitions, encouraging children to read more and improve their skills. Parents noticed significant changes in their children's interest in reading, and many reported that their kids were now reading at least two books a week.
ingles.question: What impact did the library activities have on the children according to the text?
options: A) They lost interest in reading.
B) They began to read more frequently.
C) They preferred video games over books.
D) They stopped attending the library.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: The correct answer is B) They began to read more frequently. This choice reflects the text's main message about the positive influence of library activities on children's reading habits. The distractors are misleading: A) contradicts the text, while C) and D) present scenarios that are not supported by the information provided. The passage emphasizes improvement in reading interest due to the library, aligning perfectly with the correct option.

ingles.context_text: Many people believe that reading books is more beneficial than watching movies. Books allow readers to imagine the characters and settings, creating a personal connection with the story. Additionally, reading can enhance vocabulary and comprehension skills, while movies often provide a more passive experience. However, movies can also convey emotions through visual effects and music, making them impactful in a different way. Ultimately, both mediums have their unique advantages and can complement each other.
ingles.question: What is one advantage of reading books compared to watching movies as mentioned in the text?
options: A) Movies are more exciting than books.
B) Books help improve vocabulary and comprehension skills.
C) Watching movies requires less time than reading.
D) Books have more visual effects than movies.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta ya que el texto menciona específicamente que la lectura puede mejorar las habilidades de vocabulario y comprensión, lo que destaca una ventaja clara de leer frente a ver películas. La opción A es incorrecta porque, aunque puede ser cierto que algunas personas encuentren películas más emocionantes, el texto no lo afirma. La opción C es engañosa ya que el tiempo puede variar según la longitud del libro o la película, y el texto no menciona este aspecto. La opción D es incorrecta porque, en realidad, los libros dependen de la imaginación del lector y no tienen efectos visuales intrínsecos como las películas.

ingles.context_text: Emma loves to explore new cuisines from around the world. Last week, she tried cooking Italian pasta for the first time. She gathered fresh ingredients, including tomatoes, basil, and garlic. While preparing the dish, she realized the importance of using quality ingredients for a flavorful meal. After cooking, she invited her friends to taste her creation, and they all enjoyed it immensely. Inspired by their compliments, Emma decided to start an online blog to share her cooking experiences and recipes with others.
ingles.question: What motivated Emma to start her cooking blog?
options: A) Her love for Italian food.
B) The compliments from her friends.
C) Her interest in Italian culture.
D) The quality of the ingredients.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) porque el texto menciona que Emma decidió comenzar un blog después de que sus amigos disfrutaran de su comida y la elogiaran. Esta afirmación resalta la relación directa entre los cumplidos de sus amigos y su motivación para compartir sus experiencias culinarias. Las opciones A, C y D son distractores que, aunque están relacionadas con la cocina y los ingredientes, no son el motivo específico que la llevó a iniciar el blog. Por lo tanto, la opción B es la más precisa y directa en relación con la motivación de Emma.

ingles.context_text: In the small town of Greenfield, the community gathered every Saturday morning at the local park for a farmer's market. The market not only provided fresh produce but also served as a social hub for the townspeople. Every week, various vendors would set up their stalls, offering everything from organic vegetables to handmade crafts. It was a time for neighbors to catch up, share recipes, and even enjoy live music performed by local talent. The mayor of Greenfield often spoke about the importance of supporting local businesses and fostering community spirit, and the farmer's market epitomized this vision.
ingles.question: What is the main purpose of the farmer's market in Greenfield?
options: A) To compete with larger grocery stores.
B) To provide a venue for social interaction and support local vendors.
C) To promote tourism in the town.
D) To offer online shopping options for residents.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identify the main idea.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el texto destaca que el mercado es un punto de encuentro social y que apoya a los vendedores locales. Las demás opciones presentan distracciones. La opción A sugiere competencia, lo cual no se menciona en el texto. La C se enfoca en el turismo, que no es el propósito del mercado. Finalmente, la D habla de opciones de compras en línea, que son irrelevantes en el contexto del mercado físico descrito.

ingles.context_text: Maria loves to paint in her free time. She often visits art galleries to get inspiration from different artists. One of her favorite styles is impressionism, especially the works of Claude Monet. She enjoys the way impressionist paintings capture light and movement, making her feel as though she can step into the scene. Recently, she participated in a local art competition, and her piece was inspired by a sunny day in the park, using vibrant colors to depict the play of sunlight through the leaves.
ingles.question: What type of art does Maria particularly enjoy?
options: A) Cubism
B) Impressionism
C) Surrealism
D) Modernism
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) Impressionism, ya que el texto menciona explícitamente que Maria disfruta del estilo impresionista y se inspira en las obras de Claude Monet. Los distractores son tipos de arte que no se mencionan en el texto. A) Cubism y C) Surrealism son estilos de arte diferentes que también pueden ser atractivos, pero no son de interés para Maria según el contexto. D) Modernism es una categoría amplia que incluye varios estilos, pero no se relaciona con la preferencia de Maria por el impresionismo.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that offered a variety of books for all ages. Every Saturday, children gathered there for story time, where the librarian would read from popular children's books, inspiring young imaginations. One day, the librarian decided to introduce a new series of adventure books that featured diverse characters and exciting plots. The children were eager to explore these new stories, and each week, they would share their favorite parts with one another.
ingles.question: What was the librarian's main intention in introducing the new series of adventure books?
options: A) To discourage reading among children.
B) To inspire children's imaginations.
C) To reduce the number of story time sessions.
D) To focus on books only for older readers.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifying the main idea.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) porque la intención del bibliotecario al introducir una nueva serie de libros de aventura fue precisamente inspirar la imaginación de los niños, tal como se menciona en el texto. Las opciones A), C) y D) son distractores que contradicen el propósito descrito en el contexto, ya que ninguna refleja la intención positiva del bibliotecario de fomentar la lectura y la imaginación en los niños, lo cual es el enfoque principal del pasaje.

ingles.context_text: The importance of renewable energy sources has been widely recognized as a critical aspect of tackling climate change. Solar, wind, and hydroelectric power offer sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels. Transitioning to these energy sources not only helps reduce carbon emissions but also leads to a more stable energy supply over time. Furthermore, investing in renewable energy creates numerous jobs and stimulates economic growth in various sectors.
ingles.question: What is one of the main benefits of transitioning to renewable energy sources?
options: A) It decreases the number of jobs available.
B) It leads to a more stable energy supply.
C) It increases reliance on fossil fuels.
D) It has no impact on climate change.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es la opción B, ya que el texto menciona que una de las ventajas de las energías renovables es que conduce a un suministro energético más estable a largo plazo. Las otras opciones son distractores que presentan información incorrecta: A implica que la transición a energías renovables disminuye el empleo, lo cual es falso; C contradice el hecho de que las energías renovables son alternativas a los combustibles fósiles; D es incorrecta, ya que el texto claramente establece que estas fuentes ayudan a combatir el cambio climático.

ingles.context_text: The discovery of penicillin in 1928 by Alexander Fleming revolutionized medicine. This antibiotic, derived from the Penicillium mold, has saved countless lives by effectively treating bacterial infections. Its use during World War II significantly reduced the number of deaths from infected wounds. As a result, penicillin is often considered one of the most important medical breakthroughs of the 20th century.
ingles.question: What was a significant impact of penicillin during World War II?
options: A) It was used to treat viral infections.
B) It reduced deaths from infected wounds.
C) It created a new type of bacteria.
D) It increased the cost of medical supplies.
ingles.skill: Comprensión lectora; Identifica el impacto de un descubrimiento científico.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B, ya que el texto menciona que el uso de la penicilina durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial redujo significativamente el número de muertes causadas por heridas infectadas. Las otras opciones son distractores: A es incorrecta porque la penicilina no trata infecciones virales; C es falsa ya que la penicilina no creó un nuevo tipo de bacteria, sino que combate las existentes; D es incorrecta porque el texto no menciona un aumento en los costos de suministros médicos por el uso de penicilina. Esta pregunta evalúa la capacidad de los estudiantes para extraer información clave de un texto.

ingles.context_text: Maria is planning a weekend trip to the mountains. She has been looking at weather forecasts and packing her essentials. She wants to make sure she has everything needed for a safe and enjoyable time outdoors, including a tent, sleeping bag, and enough food and water. Maria is particularly excited about hiking and exploring the scenic views the mountains have to offer.
ingles.question: What is Maria most excited about for her weekend trip?
options: A) Packing her essentials
B) The weather forecasts
C) Hiking and exploring
D) Setting up her tent
ingles.justification: El objetivo de la pregunta es evaluar la capacidad del estudiante para identificar la idea principal del texto. La opción correcta es C) Hiking and exploring, ya que Maria expresa su emoción por esta actividad específica. Los distractores, A), B) y D) son aspectos del viaje, pero no capturan la principal fuente de entusiasmo de Maria, que es la aventura al aire libre. Por lo tanto, los estudiantes deben centrarse en el propósito principal de su viaje para responder correctamente.

ingles.context_text: The sun was setting over the horizon, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink. As the day came to a close, families gathered in the park, sharing laughter and stories. Some children played on the swings while others chased after a kite that danced in the gentle breeze. The sound of music filled the air from a nearby festival, creating a festive atmosphere. It was a perfect end to the day, where everyone seemed to appreciate the beauty around them.
ingles.question: What activity were families engaged in during the sunset?
options: A) Watching a movie
B) Sharing laughter and stories
C) Eating dinner at a restaurant
D) Going shopping
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B) 'Sharing laughter and stories', ya que el texto menciona explícitamente que las familias se reunieron en el parque para compartir risas y relatos. Las otras opciones son distractores que no se derivan del contexto: A) 'Watching a movie' no es mencionado, C) 'Eating dinner at a restaurant' es irrelevante al contexto del parque, y D) 'Going shopping' no tiene relación con la actividad descrita. Esto permite al estudiante identificar la idea principal y entender el ambiente descrito en el texto.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, a bakery is famous for its delicious bread and pastries. Every morning, the baker wakes up before dawn to start preparing the dough. Customers often line up outside the shop to get their favorite treats. One day, a new bakery opened just across the street, offering similar products. The original bakery's owner worried that his loyal customers might start visiting the new place. He decided to improve his recipes and add new items to his menu to keep his customers coming back.
ingles.question: What action did the original bakery owner take to retain his customers?
options: A) He closed his bakery for a week.
B) He improved his recipes and added new items.
C) He reduced the prices of his pastries.
D) He started selling only bread.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identify the main idea.
ingles.justification: La cuestión se centra en las acciones tomadas por el dueño de la panadería original para asegurar la lealtad de sus clientes. La opción correcta es la B), ya que el texto menciona específicamente que el dueño decidió 'mejorar sus recetas y añadir nuevos elementos a su menú'. Las otras opciones (A, C, y D) son distractores que no están respaldados por el texto. La opción A es incorrecta porque no se menciona el cierre temporal del negocio. La opción C, aunque podría atraer clientes, no es una acción tomada en el contexto del texto. La opción D es incorrecta porque el dueño no se limitó a un solo producto. Por lo tanto, la B) es la única respuesta que refleja el sentido correcto de mantener la clientela a través de mejoras en la oferta del producto.

ingles.context_text: While walking through the park, Emily noticed a group of people gathered around a large tree. Curious, she approached and saw that they were watching a skilled artist painting a beautiful landscape. The artist worked meticulously, capturing the vibrant colors of the sunset and the intricate details of the surrounding nature. Emily felt inspired by the artist's dedication and decided to sit on a nearby bench to observe the creative process.
ingles.question: What does Emily feel while watching the artist?
options: A) Boredom
B) Inspiration
C) Frustration
D) Indifference
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B) Inspiration, ya que el texto menciona que Emily se siente inspirada por la dedicación del artista. Las demás opciones son distractores que no reflejan la reacción emocional descrita en el contexto. A) Boredom, C) Frustration y D) Indifference son sentimientos que no se mencionan en el texto y, por lo tanto, no son correctos.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there lived a young girl named Lily who loved to paint. Every day after school, she would gather her brushes and canvas and create beautiful landscapes of the fields and rivers nearby. One day, she decided to enter a local art competition. Nervous but excited, she spent weeks perfecting her painting, pouring her heart into every stroke. When the day of the competition arrived, Lily's artwork was displayed alongside many others, and the judges were impressed by her talent.
ingles.question: What was Lily's main motivation for painting?
options: A) To impress her friends.
B) To express her feelings through art.
C) To win a competition.
D) To earn money from selling her paintings.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el texto menciona que Lily 'pouring her heart into every stroke', lo cual sugiere que su principal motivación es expresar sus sentimientos a través de la pintura. Las otras opciones son distracciones que pueden parecer viables, pero no reflejan la esencia de la motivación que se describe en el texto. La opción A se basa en la opinión de otros, la opción C se centra en el resultado del concurso y no en la actividad misma, y la opción D implica un interés comercial que no se menciona en el contexto.

ingles.context_text: In a small village by the sea, the residents relied on fishing for their livelihood. Each morning, the fishermen would set out in their boats, hoping for a good catch. The sun would rise over the horizon, casting a golden light on the water. Children played on the sandy beach while the elders shared stories of the sea's many mysteries. One day, a fierce storm came unexpectedly, and the fishermen struggled to navigate their boats back to shore amidst the crashing waves. This event reminded everyone of the power of nature and the importance of community support.
ingles.question: What do the fishermen rely on for their livelihood?
options: A) Agriculture
B) Fishing
C) Tourism
D) Crafting
ingles.justification: The correct answer is B) Fishing, as the text explicitly states that the residents, particularly the fishermen, depended on fishing for their livelihood. The other options serve as distractors: A) Agriculture is incorrect because there is no mention of farming; C) Tourism is not referenced in the text at all; and D) Crafting, while a possible activity, is not mentioned as a primary source of income. This question assesses the ability to extract key information from the text.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that offered various programs for children. Every Saturday, they held storytelling sessions where kids could listen to their favorite stories read aloud. The librarian, Ms. Johnson, loved to encourage children to explore the world of books. She often organized a 'Reading Challenge' during the summer, where kids earned rewards for reading a certain number of books. This initiative not only improved their reading skills but also fostered a love for literature among the young participants.
ingles.question: What was the purpose of the 'Reading Challenge' organized by Ms. Johnson?
options: A) To entertain the children during summer vacation.
B) To encourage children to read more books.
C) To promote the library's storytelling sessions.
D) To collect donations for new books.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el texto establece claramente que el propósito del 'Reading Challenge' era fomentar el hábito de la lectura entre los niños. Aunque la opción A sugiere diversión, no refleja el objetivo educativo. La opción C se refiere a las sesiones de narración, pero no aborda directamente el propósito del reto. La opción D, que habla de donaciones, no está mencionada en el texto, lo que la convierte en un distractor no relevante.

ingles.context_text: The sun was setting over the small town of Willow Creek, casting a warm golden hue over the quaint houses. Children were playing in the park, their laughter filling the air, while nearby, a couple was enjoying a picnic under a large oak tree. As the sun dipped lower, the sky transformed into a canvas of oranges, pinks, and purples, creating a breathtaking view that took the breath away from anyone who witnessed it.
ingles.question: What setting is being described in the passage?
options: A) A busy city during the day.
B) A tranquil town at sunset.
C) A beach during a storm.
D) A mountain village in winter.
ingles.justification: The passage vividly describes the peaceful evening ambiance of Willow Creek, particularly emphasizing the sunset and the activities of the townspeople. Option B) correctly captures this serene setting, while the other options represent different scenarios that do not align with the text's description. Option A) suggests a busy environment, which contradicts the tranquility mentioned; Option C) and D) present entirely different atmospheric conditions (a stormy beach and a winter mountain), making them incorrect.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a unique library that stayed open only at night. It was a place where people gathered to read under the stars and share stories. The librarian, an elderly man named Mr. Williams, believed that the quiet of the night helped people think deeply and reflect on their lives. One evening, a group of children came to the library and asked Mr. Williams about his favorite book. He smiled and told them it was a story about adventure and friendship, which inspired him to create the nighttime library.
ingles.question: What did Mr. Williams believe about reading at night?
options: A) It is difficult to concentrate due to distractions.
B) It helps people think deeply and reflect on their lives.
C) Most people prefer reading during the day.
D) It is only suitable for children.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es la opción B porque refleja la creencia de Mr. Williams sobre la lectura nocturna, que es que permite a las personas pensar profundamente. Las opciones A, C y D son distractores que presentan afirmaciones incorrectas o generalizaciones que no se mencionan en el texto. La opción A sugiere que hay distracciones, lo cual contradice la idea de reflexión. La opción C afirma que la mayoría prefiere leer durante el día, lo que no se aborda en el contexto. La opción D limita el público objetivo solo a los niños, ignorando que el enfoque de Mr. Williams es más amplio y abarca a todos los lectores en su biblioteca nocturna.

ingles.context_text: In a small coastal town, there was a famous bakery known for its delicious pastries. Every morning, the sweet aroma of freshly baked goods would waft through the streets, attracting locals and tourists alike. One day, a new bakery opened just down the street, claiming to use traditional recipes passed down through generations. As the competition grew, the original bakery decided to hold a baking contest to showcase their unique skills and recipes. The townspeople eagerly anticipated the event, excited to taste the best pastries the town had to offer.
ingles.question: What was the primary reason for the original bakery to hold a baking contest?
options: A) To attract more tourists to the town.
B) To showcase their unique skills and recipes.
C) To reduce their baking costs.
D) To improve their business strategy.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es la opción B, ya que el texto menciona explícitamente que la panadería original decidió realizar un concurso de repostería para 'mostrar sus habilidades y recetas únicas'. Las otras opciones son distractores que pueden parecer lógicas, pero no se mencionan en el texto. La opción A se refiere a atraer turistas, pero no es el enfoque del concurso. La opción C sobre reducir costos no tiene relación con el contexto del evento, y la opción D, que sugiere mejorar la estrategia empresarial, tampoco se menciona en el texto. Por lo tanto, B es la respuesta que refleja más fielmente el propósito del concurso según el contexto.

ingles.context_text: During the summer vacation, Maria decided to volunteer at a local animal shelter. She spent her days feeding the animals, cleaning their habitats, and helping with adoptions. Through this experience, she learned a lot about responsibility and the importance of caring for animals. She made new friends and felt fulfilled as she contributed to the well-being of the shelter.
ingles.question: What did Maria learn from her experience at the shelter?
options: A) The importance of being alone.
B) The value of responsibility and caring for animals.
C) How to train animals for competitions.
D) The best places to adopt pets.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) porque el texto menciona explícitamente que Maria aprendió acerca de la responsabilidad y la importancia de cuidar a los animales durante su tiempo como voluntaria. Las otras opciones, aunque relacionadas con el tema, no se mencionan en el contexto. A) sugiere un enfoque antitético a la experiencia comunitaria de Maria. C) introduce un concepto que no se discute en el texto. Y D) aunque podría ser un resultado de las adopciones, no es lo que Maria aprendió directamente.

ingles.context_text: Maria loves to paint landscapes. She often goes to the park to find inspiration from nature. One sunny afternoon, she sat beneath an old oak tree, observing the way the sunlight filtered through the leaves. While painting, she listened to the gentle rustle of the wind and the cheerful chirping of birds. After a few hours, she stepped back to admire her work, feeling a sense of accomplishment as she captured the beauty of the scene on her canvas.
ingles.question: What is the main activity that Maria enjoys?
options: A) Playing music
B) Painting landscapes
C) Taking photographs
D) Writing stories
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: The context clearly describes Maria's passion for painting landscapes, making option B the correct answer. The other options serve as distractors: A) Playing music is unrelated to the context; C) Taking photographs and D) Writing stories are not mentioned in the text, which focuses specifically on her painting activities. This question tests the student’s ability to distill the primary focus of the text.

ingles.context_text: In the small town of Greenfield, a young girl named Emma discovered a hidden library behind her school. Every afternoon after class, she would visit this magical place filled with books of all kinds. One day, she found an ancient book that told stories of brave knights and mythical creatures. The more she read, the more she wanted to share these stories with her friends, believing that they would love the adventures just as much as she did.
ingles.question: What does Emma discover in her school?
options: A) A new classroom.
B) A hidden library.
C) A playground.
D) A science lab.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B) A hidden library, ya que el texto menciona explícitamente que Emma descubrió una biblioteca oculta detrás de su escuela. Las otras opciones (A, C, D) son distractores que no tienen relación con el contexto del descubrimiento descrito en el texto, lo que puede llevar a confusión si el lector no se concentra en la información principal. Esta pregunta analiza la habilidad de identificación de ideas principales, una competencia clave en la comprensión lectora.

ingles.context_text: In a small village, the residents decided to host a weekly market to promote local products. Every Saturday, farmers, bakers, and artisans gather to sell their goods. The market has become a social event where people not only buy fresh produce but also enjoy various activities, such as music performances and cooking demonstrations. Over time, this initiative has strengthened the community bonds and boosted the local economy.
ingles.question: What is the main purpose of the weekly market in the village?
options: A) To entertain tourists visiting the village.
B) To promote local products and strengthen community bonds.
C) To sell imported goods at lower prices.
D) To provide a venue for large-scale festivals.
ingles.justification: La pregunta se centra en identificar el propósito principal del mercado semanal en el contexto proporcionado. La opción B es la correcta, ya que el texto menciona que el mercado tiene como objetivo promover productos locales y fortalecer los lazos comunitarios. Las otras opciones, aunque pueden parecer plausibles, no reflejan la intención central del evento. Opción A se refiere a los turistas, lo cual no es el enfoque principal; opción C menciona productos importados, que no es relevante en este contexto; y opción D se aleja del objetivo descrito, que es más social y local que festivo y de gran escala.

ingles.context_text: In a small village, the townspeople gathered every Saturday to share stories and enjoy each other's company. One day, a traveler arrived and began to tell tales of distant lands, sparking the imagination of everyone present. The villagers listened intently, fascinated by the traveler's adventures and experiences. They realized that every story carried a lesson, and through these stories, they learned about bravery, friendship, and the importance of community.
ingles.question: What is the main lesson the villagers learned from the traveler's stories?
options: A) The value of material wealth.
B) The importance of bravery and friendship.
C) The need for isolation from outsiders.
D) The disadvantages of storytelling.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es la B) porque el texto enfatiza cómo los relatos del viajero enseñaron a los aldeanos sobre la valentía y la amistad. Las otras opciones actúan como distractores: la A) sugiere que el dinero tiene valor, lo cual no es el enfoque del texto; la C) implica que deberían alejarse de otros, lo que contradice la idea de comunidad; y la D) sugiere que la narración es negativa, lo que no se apoya en el texto. Así, la B) se alinea perfectamente con el mensaje principal, mientras que los distractores confunden al lector al desviarse del contexto.

ingles.context_text: John has always been fascinated by the stars. Every night, he goes to his backyard with a telescope and spends hours observing the sky. Last week, he read about the phases of the moon and decided to document them. He took notes on how the moon changed from a new moon to a full moon, observing its brightness and shape. He also learned about constellations and was excited to identify Orion and the Big Dipper in the clear night sky. His passion for astronomy has grown, and he hopes to become an astronomer one day.
ingles.question: What is John most likely to aspire to in the future?
options: A) To become a professional photographer.
B) To become an astronomer.
C) To work in a lab.
D) To be a science writer.
ingles.skill: Reading comprehension; Identifies the main idea.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) 'To become an astronomer.' El texto menciona que John tiene una gran fascinación por las estrellas y que ha estado aprendiendo sobre astronomía, además de expresar su deseo de convertirse en astrónomo algún día. Las otras opciones son distractores, ya que no están respaldadas por información en el texto. La opción A) se refiere a la fotografía, que no se menciona; C) habla de un trabajo en un laboratorio, que no coincide con sus intereses; y D) menciona la escritura científica, que tampoco es indicada en el contexto. El objetivo del ejercicio es evaluar la capacidad del estudiante para identificar las aspiraciones de una persona según el contexto presentado.

ingles.context_text: Maria is planning a trip to the mountains next weekend. She wants to enjoy the beautiful scenery, hike some trails, and possibly see some wildlife. However, she is also concerned about the weather and whether she should pack extra layers of clothing. She has heard that the temperatures can drop significantly in the evenings. Maria is excited but a bit anxious about being fully prepared.
ingles.question: What is Maria's main concern regarding her trip?
options: A) Finding the best hiking trails.
B) The weather and proper clothing.
C) Spotting wildlife during her hike.
D) Enjoying the scenery and nature.
ingles.justification: La pregunta busca evaluar la capacidad del estudiante para identificar la preocupación principal de Maria que se menciona explícitamente en el texto. ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that had books from different genres. Every Saturday, the library held storytime for children, where a volunteer would read a story aloud. ingles.context_text: Maria loves animals and has decided to adopt a pet. She goes to the animal shelter where different kinds of animals are available for adoption. The other options (cat, parrot, and turtle) are presented as alternatives but are not chosen by her. Therefore, the correct answer is C) A puppy. The other distractors may seem plausible as they are common pets, but they do not fit the criteria Maria uses for her decision.

ingles.context_text: In a small coastal town, many fishermen relied on the ocean for their livelihood. Every morning, they set out to sea, hoping for a good catch. However, over the years, the fish population began to decline due to overfishing and pollution. The community decided to take action by implementing sustainable fishing practices. They established a no-fishing zone to allow fish populations to recover and set limits on the amount of fish that could be caught. As a result, not only did the fish return, but the town also saw an increase in tourism, as visitors came to enjoy the revitalized marine life.
ingles.question: What was one positive outcome of implementing sustainable fishing practices in the town?
options: A) The fishermen had to stop fishing completely.
B) The fish population began to recover.
C) Pollution levels increased significantly.
D) No fishing zones decreased tourism.
ingles.justification: La opción correcta es B) porque el texto menciona claramente que la implementación de prácticas de pesca sostenible llevó a la recuperación de la población de peces. Las otras opciones son distracciones: A) es incorrecta, ya que los pescadores no pararon de pescar, solo se reglamentó; C) contradice el texto, que sugiere reducción de la contaminación; y D) también es errónea, dado que se menciona que el turismo aumentó gracias a la revitalización de la vida marina.

ingles.context_text: As the sun began to set, the colors in the sky transformed into a breathtaking palette of orange, pink, and purple. Sarah stood on the beach, feeling the soft sand beneath her feet. She took a deep breath, appreciating the moment of tranquility after a long day at work. The rhythmic sound of the waves calmed her mind as she watched the horizon. A group of seagulls flew overhead, their silhouettes contrasting against the vibrant sky. In that instant, all her worries seemed to fade away.

B) Happiness
C) Confusion
D) Boredom

Los distractores presentan emociones que no son coherentes con la situación descrita: A) Anger y D) Boredom no son compatibles con el disfrute de un paisaje tan hermoso, mientras que C) Confusion no se considera relevante en el contexto de una experiencia placentera. Así, la opción B es la única que refleja correctamente el estado emocional de Sarah.

ingles.context_text: Maria is planning a surprise birthday party for her friend. She has chosen a theme of 'under the sea' and is excited to decorate her house with blue and green colors. La opción A (Jungle), C (Space) y D (Winter wonderland) son irrelevantes y confusas, ya que no tienen relación con la fiesta descrita, lo que aumenta la dificultad de discernir la respuesta correcta si no se presta atención al contexto.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a bakery known for its delicious pastries. Every morning, customers would line up to buy fresh bread, muffins, and cookies. Las otras opciones, aunque pueden ser actividades secundarias en un entorno social, no reflejan la razón principal mencionada en el texto. La opción A, aunque válida, no es el foco del texto. ingles.context_text: Maria has recently moved to a new city and is exploring her neighborhood. One day, she discovers a quaint little café that offers a variety of pastries and coffee. La opción A) es un distractor porque, aunque ella quiere conocer gente nueva, eso surge después de su visita. ingles.context_text: The sun was setting over the horizon, painting the sky with shades of orange and pink. ingles.context_text: The importance of preserving biodiversity cannot be overstated. Biodiversity is the variety of life on Earth, including the different species of plants, animals, and microorganisms, as well as the ecosystems they form. Losing biodiversity threatens food security, disrupts ecosystems, and diminishes resilience against climate change. Moreover, many communities rely on biodiversity for their resources, livelihoods, and cultural heritage. Therefore, protecting our planet's diverse life forms is crucial for sustaining human well-being.
ingles.question: What is one of the main reasons for preserving biodiversity mentioned in the text?
options: A) It is a requirement for academic studies.
B) It enhances climate change resilience.
C) It guarantees technological advancement.
D) It increases urbanization levels.
ingles.justification: La respuesta correcta es B) porque el texto menciona que la pérdida de biodiversidad disminuye la resiliencia frente al cambio climático. Esta idea resalta la conexión entre la biodiversidad y la capacidad de los ecosistemas para adaptarse y recuperarse de los efectos del cambio climático. Las otras opciones son distractores: A) habla de requisitos académicos que no son relevantes al contexto del texto; C) sugiere una relación que no se menciona, y D) menciona un aspecto que no es positivo ni se relaciona con la preservación de la biodiversidad. En general, la opción B) es la que mejor resume una de las razones clave para conservar la biodiversidad mencionadas en el texto.

ingles.context_text: In a small town, there was a library that was cherished by its residents. Every week, children and adults would gather to read books, attend workshops, and share stories. ingles.context_text: In a small town, a young girl named Lily discovers an old diary in her attic. The diary belonged to her grandmother and contains stories about her life during the war. ingles.context_text: In a small village, the residents had a problem with stray dogs. They decided to hold a meeting to discuss possible solutions. ingles.context_text: The industrial revolution was a period of great change that began in the late 18th century. During this time, countries transitioned from agrarian economies to industrialized ones. This shift led to the creation of factories, which concentrated labor in one place, thus changing the nature of work and the economy. Innovations in technology, such as the steam engine and spinning jenny, dramatically increased production rates and efficiency. However, this rapid industrialization also raised concerns about working conditions, environmental impact, and social inequality.
ingles.question: What was a significant consequence of the industrial revolution according to the text?
options: A) A decrease in population growth.
B) The rise of factory-based labor.
C) Improvements in agricultural methods.
D) The elimination of social classes.
ingles.justification: La opción B es correcta porque el texto destaca que la revolución industrial implicó la creación de fábricas y una concentración del trabajo en un solo lugar. Las otras opciones son distractores; la opción A sugiere una disminución de la población, que no se menciona en el texto. La opción C se refiere a la agricultura, que no es el enfoque del texto, y la opción D es incorrecta ya que la revolución industrial contribuyó a la desigualdad social, no a su eliminación.

ingles.context_text: Emma had always loved painting. Growing up, she spent countless hours in her grandmother's attic, surrounded by old canvases and brushes.
